requirements.text: technician updates a work order with tenant-scoped authorization
dispatcher assigns work orders and sees auditable transitions
write API monthly availability objective is 99.9%
accepted writes preserve idempotency and tenant isolation
derived AI suggestions may be rebuilt without losing business facts

consistency_decisions.scope: authorized work-order state and audit history
consistency_decisions.tradeoff: one PostgreSQL transaction preserves invariants but adds coordination latency and makes database availability part of the write path
consistency_decisions.failure_behavior: fail the write without acknowledging success; retry only through the idempotency contract

consistency_decisions.scope: rebuildable AI suggestion and retrieval index
consistency_decisions.tradeoff: asynchronous rebuild isolates the core workflow but suggestions may be stale until the derived consumer catches up
consistency_decisions.failure_behavior: show suggestions as unavailable or stale while Java/PostgreSQL business facts remain authoritative

failure_modes.mitigate: reject writes clearly and preserve idempotency keys
failure_modes.residual_risk: accepted but unreplicated commits may follow declared RPO

failure_modes.recover: promote last verified artifact or complete forward fix
failure_modes.residual_risk: schema compatibility can make rollback unsafe

failure_modes.detect: derived suggestion latency and error SLI
failure_modes.recover: restart/rebuild derived index after Java API authorizes data

slos.indicator: authorized work-order writes returning intended outcome
slos.error_budget_policy: freeze risky promotion when burn policy is breached

adr.decision: begin with a Java modular monolith and PostgreSQL business authority; keep Python AI derived and rebuildable
consequences: single transactional boundary for core workflow
module boundaries and observability are mandatory
AI failure does not own or corrupt work-order truth
rejected_options: microservices now: team and independent scaling evidence absent
Python as business system of record: conflicts with authorization and audit boundary
evolution_triggers: at least four independently deploying teams for two quarters
one module needs independently proven 10x load isolation
measured release coupling violates SLO despite modular remediation
adr.rollback: retain module contracts and deploy as one artifact if extraction fails acceptance gates
